name: RC-B10-0372/2025 – After § 26 – Am 55
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Gaza at breaking point: EU action to combat famine, the urgent need to release hostages and move towards a two-state solution
part_text: 26b. Calls for the recognition that Israel has created and maintained a system of apartheid, established as a crime against humanity in both the 1973 International Convention on the Suppression and Punishment of the Crime of Apartheid and the 1998 Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court, and calls on the Member States to use all means possible to dismantle this system as recommended by multiple Palestinian, Israeli and international NGOs, as well as International Court of Justice’s advisory opinion of 19 July 2024;
